r4lineups 2.3.0 release checklist

Source: RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md

This is the sole CRAN and JOSS publication candidate. Versions 2.0.0, 2.1.0 and 2.2.0 were never submitted and must not be; their archives in cran_submission_2026-10-27/ and earlier are historical.

2.3.0 contains the fixes from three independent reviews (codex_qa_1.md, 28 October; codex_review_2.md, 29 October; codex_review_3.md, 30 October 2026) and an independent statistical audit (notes/statistical-qa/, 31 October 2026), together with a convergence fix in fit_max_sdt() found by CI. None of these files is in the build. See NEWS.md.
